$comment: Advisories that npm audit reports but which do not apply to Fleet, with the
reason and a date to look again. Anything not listed here fails the build at
An entry is a claim that has to stay true. scripts/audit.mjs fails if an
entry stops matching anything (the advisory was fixed and the exception is
now noise) or if its review date has passed — so this file cannot quietly
become a list of things nobody looked at again.
